user_review.method: Executed isolated deterministic acceptance on Linux/Python 3.13.5, including the original 37 tests, four retained audit assertions and new fault/shell tests. No live model eval, authenticated host session, independent sub-agent or user-machine installation test was performed in this environment.

scenarios.request: Organize with a non-UTF-8 reference file.
scenarios.expected: Refuse before changing work files or retain actionable recovery after any mutation.
scenarios.observed: Preflight rejects the unreadable reference; original files unchanged. Retained audit assertion passed.

scenarios.request: Interrupt after destination write but before the completed journal entry.
scenarios.expected: Keep operation identity and recovery; never claim no change from an empty journal.
scenarios.observed: Fault injection left a destination file and an empty completed list; response retained recovery and partial_or_unverified; rollback restored input.

scenarios.request: Run displayed undo commands for literal dollar signs, quotes, spaces and Chinese paths.
scenarios.expected: Use the current interpreter and literal argv, with shell-specific rendering.
scenarios.observed: POSIX shell commands executed and restored original files. Windows-specific test is collected separately in CI; no Windows result is inferred from POSIX.

scenarios.request: Resume a moved folder containing an incomplete operation.
scenarios.expected: Find recovery read-only and use the new path.
scenarios.observed: Returned operation ID and updated rollback argv, with identical bytes before/after resume; completed preimages were not rehashed.

similar_skills.learned: Selected task state and bounded recovery; static files are not proof of external state. Rechecked blob e13bd532ef7d6407f55b1ac34d8334c99cef4ee1.
similar_skills.reason: Retain task-local recovery discovery without host hooks or session-store reads.

similar_skills.learned: Explicit mutations and restorable snapshots; distinguish filesystem facts from judgments. Rechecked blob 836499a56bf7622b58f7d6636e06617f3b34b5d6.
similar_skills.reason: Keep existing transaction engine and conflict refusal; only improve reports, path handling and recovery discovery.

All three isolated demo contexts executed apply and byte-restoring rollback.
